text:
ali: FYI — Legal forwarded a customer audit ask about RBAC + KMS evidence. They want a clear plan for key rotation proofs, backfill, and SLA for evidence delivery. Who can jump on this?

maria: I can. Can you paste the exact asks from the customer/legal?

ali: From the email: (1) show key rotation timeline with signatures, (2) ability to regenerate a tenant-scoped export bundle for the last 180 days, (3) correlate RBAC changes to user identities (pre/post diffs), (4) contractual SLA for evidence delivery (48–72h) and penalties if we miss.

jordan: Quick note — we emit admin.audit events for key rotations today but payloads are sparse. We have action=key_rotate but no prev_key_id or signature field. We'll need to extend the schema.

samir: We persist rotations in audit-db, but signed bundles are not a thing yet. Backfilling 180d is painful: hot retention is 90d, cold storage 1yr but slower. Generating signed bundles from cold storage will be a batch job and cost ops cycles.

maria: Legal will push hard on 180d. Options: (a) hosted default 90d, (b) paid retention upgrade to 180d for Dedicated/Private, (c) provide sampled attestations for hosted. Need cost estimates. :thinking_face:

ali: @legal — any flexibility on the 180d ask for hosted customers? We need to be explicit in contract language.

legal: Customers ask 180d frequently but it's not a universal requirement. Recommend tiers: hosted default 90d, premium (Dedicated/Private) 180d+ with addendum and fee. For signed bundles, propose SLA: 72h standard, 24h expedited with fee. Include a force-majeure and proveable timestamping clause.

jordan: Technical followups: propose new audit schema audit_v2 for key events with fields: key_id, prev_key_id, rotation_ts, actor_id, signature_kms_id, claim_hash. Backfill pipeline: replay from cold -> signer job -> produce signed bundle (tar + metadata + signature). RBAC changes: store pre/post role JSON and change_reason.

samir: Security note for vuln triage: signing flow must be isolated and minimal privileges. Signing job only reads audit export, calls KMS/ HSM to sign, writes signed artifact metadata. No write access to key material. Recommend canary on staging KMS key.

maria: UX/ops ask: add a "Create audit evidence request" flow in Console where customers request timeframe and delivery SLA. Backend should return ticket id and expected completion window. UI must show status: pending/processing/ready/failed.

ali: Also need API contract for bundle requests: return codes and semantics. Example: 202 Accepted (processing), 200 with signed URL, 422 unsupported timeframe, 429 rate-limited, 500 transient error with retry-after.

audits-bot: audit-bot: created SEC-1247 "Audit evidence bundle generation" assigned to @samir, due 2w.

jordan: Compliance escalation: FedRAMP/HIPAA customers will request chain-of-custody and notarization. Notarization requires third-party attestation and will be an SOW.

legal: Confirmed — notarization & third-party attestation is feasible but only under Dedicated/Private with SOW. We'll draft contract language and add pricing options.

ali: Action items: (1) draft new audit_v2 schema + example signed bundle (jordan), (2) Console endpoint and UI wireframe for audit requests (maria), (3) retention and cost model + backfill ops plan (samir), (4) contract addendum language for retention/SLA/notarization (legal). I'll consolidate and send to customer by EOW. :+1:

maria: I'll start a short RFC with schema proposal and UI mockups.

samir: I'll estimate infra cost for backfill and signing throughput.

ali: Thanks everyone — tagging @audits-bot to keep the ticket linked.

jordan: Minor: include a sample event snippet in RFC:```
{
  "audit_version": "v2",
  "event_type": "key_rotate",
  "tenant_id": "t-1234",
  "key_id": "k-2025-04",
  "prev_key_id": "k-2021-07",
  "rotation_ts": "2025-04-22T15:12:03Z",
  "actor_id": "admin@redwood.co",
  "signature_kms_id": "kms:us-east1:signer-key-1",
  "claim_hash": "sha256:..."
}```

ali: Perfect. That snippet should help Legal + customer. Last note: keep PII out of bundles unless requested under BAA/FedRAMP SOW.

legal: Agreed. Default bundles must redacted for PII; full content only under BAA/SOW.

ali: Closing — I'll collate and send.
